title: 台灣高中GSAT英文單字挑戰

vocabulary.example: The king abdicated the throne after a long period of illness.
vocabulary.example_translation: 因疾病長期虛弱，而退位

vocabulary.meaning: 滿足某人的需求或願望，安排住宿或食宿
表達自己想法或意見，講清楚
vocabulary.example: He is an articulate speaker and can express himself well.
vocabulary.example_translation: 他是一位能表達自己意見的演講者

vocabulary.meaning: 增加或加強某事物，鞏固
vocabulary.example: The new policy will bolster the economy.
The bookstore will catalog all the new arrivals.
vocabulary.example_translation: 書店會將新到貨書目列出

vocabulary.example: The movie was cathartic and allowed me to release my emotions.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該影片療癒性很強，使我能夠釋放自己的情緒

vocabulary.example: The story was compelling and kept me hooked.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該故事引人入勝，令我深陷其中

vocabulary.example: He is a debonair gentleman and always treats people kindly.
vocabulary.example_translation: 他是一位有禮貌且和藹的人，總是對人親善

vocabulary.example: The value of the stock depreciated after the company went bankrupt.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該公司破產後，股票的價值大幅下跌

vocabulary.example: The news of his death quickly disseminated around the world.
vocabulary.example_translation: 他的死亡消息在全球迅速散佈

vocabulary.example: The teacher made an equivocal statement and left us confused.
vocabulary.example_translation: 老師的說話含糊不清，令人糾結

vocabulary.example: The heat wave exacerbated the drought in the region.
vocabulary.example_translation: 那股熱天氣使當地的缺水問題惡化

vocabulary.meaning: 使某事物變得容易或順暢
vocabulary.example: The new software will facilitate communication between departments.
vocabulary.example_translation: 新的軟體將會使各部門之間的溝通變得更順暢

vocabulary.example: This product is inherently safe and non-toxic.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該產品內在性地存在著安全性和無毒性

vocabulary.meaning: 進行戰術或戰略的行動
vocabulary.example: The company will maneuver to stay competitive in the market.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該公司將會進行戰略行動來維持在市場的競爭力
